summary: AI software such as chatbots or large language models cannot be listed as an author. Authors who use AI in preparing a manuscript, including drafting or editing text, must briefly describe that use during submission, and they remain fully accountable for fact-checking AI outputs. The page says nothing about AI images or AI use by reviewers and editors.

evidence.quote: may not be listed as an author
If AI software was used in the preparation of the manuscript, including drafting or editing text, this must be briefly described during the submission process
Authors are solely accountable for, and must thoroughly fact-check, outputs created with the help of AI software.
